notes.title: NPC System! The 0.16 objective of Qiuqiu Town Story
notes.notes:
A1. Add interactive placement permission Settings and steal tags
A2. Increase the initial items of the player's script
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/80afde9b1810459eeb26c27683f32d989b4e66a4.png[/img]

A3. Add more interactive prompts: attribute increase and decrease, demand dialogue bubbles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/49fc1fb8d1a52cf09f7196939d6709057a00db4f.png[/img]

A4, npc chat software, chat with NPCS on mobile phones
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/8b32892ff5d823cbfbfd2723c3b10c43fd05e8a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/8eb2cb504da6c06160bc31b9cbe0e47be9695cdf.png[/img]

B1. NPC Basics: NPCS have their own needs and attributes
B2. The NPC dialogue will say different words depending on the time, environment and requirements
B3: NPC Backpack, each has its own backpack. When the demand decreases, it will consume the edible item x inside the backpack by itself
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/026a998702e1f699545b63657cac2e81b113caf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/80afde9b1810459eeb26c27683f32d989b4e66a4.png[/img]

B4: Different options for npc favorability and conversations with NPCS will increase or decrease favorability, and favorability will affect the content of the conversation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/84c43d2063172ab96434835dff287e224918c64d.png[/img]

notes.title: More interactions! Qiu Qiu Town Story 0.15 Objective
notes.notes:
1. Scooter function realization: usage, scene switching
2. Put vehicles in the backpack
3. Scooters of different colors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/de81360a8bce61f93309ecbcd6b1809fa687ae77.png[/img]

4. Description of existing items
5. Items can be placed in the box in advance
6. Player life choice interface: Two options, villager and township-resident
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/4a1671bef691b78c9c3ca2ab70f6f4c54befc734.png[/img]

7. Increase restrictions on houses. Other people's houses cannot be entered within the specified time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/bc7d38b072ebf7f0d72ef58d7353fb8285412b77.png[/img]

8. Increase the camera's movement boundary
9. Add a lock-picking mini-game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/9a9756f555caa4b03d293b6133143e6b2bec407d.png[/img]

10. More item interactions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/977522baebc70cd9fdabfe343aa4c9ae07f34605.png[/img]
